name: Iteration Escalation — Detect
mechanical_verification: Trigger 3 VERIFY failures and observe escalation from V1.0 to V1.1 with reset to plan gate
prompt: call shark-gate action=advance gate=test then trigger verify failure 3 times using: call shark-gate action=evaluate gate=verify passed=false, then check iteration
expected_behavior: After 3 failed VERIFY evaluations, iteration escalates from V1.0 to V1.1, currentGate resets to 'plan', verifyAttempts resets to 0

verification_steps.action: Position at verify gate: call shark-gate action=advance gate=verify
Fail verify 3 times: call shark-gate action=evaluate gate=verify passed=false

verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Gate reset to plan after escalation

failure_modes.no_escalation: Iteration stays at V1.0 despite 3 failures
failure_modes.gate_not_reset: currentGate stays at verify instead of resetting to plan
failure_modes.counter_not_reset: verifyAttempts stays at 3 instead of resetting to 0
